candidate_axiom.name: Deterministic State Transitions and Immutability
candidate_axiom.statement: Every architectural state modification must occur via pure deterministic transitions operating over immutable snapshots, prohibiting in-place mutation and hidden side-effects.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: State mutations without complete lineage and snapshot isolation are rejected by the compiler.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Action Request a] ──┐
                     ├──> [Deterministic Reducer delta] ──> [New Immutable Snapshot S_t+1]
[Current Snapshot S_t] ──┘                                        │
                                                                  ▼
                                                      [Persistent Hash-Trie Memory]

Pure Reducer Dispatcher.role: Computes S_t+1 = delta(S_t, a) as a pure mathematical function.
Pure Reducer Dispatcher.invariant_rule: Prohibits in-place mutation and external I/O inside transition body.

Persistent Hash-Trie Memory.role: Maintains structural sharing across historic snapshots.
Persistent Hash-Trie Memory.invariant_rule: Memory buffers for S_t are permanently marked read-only.

Cryptographic Lineage Logger.role: Records immutable SHA-256 hash chains of transitions.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Eliminates hidden mutation and race conditions (+0.0400).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Allows instant zero-cost state rewind for audits (+0.0100).

tradeoffs.constraints: Minor memory indirection overhead from hash-tries.

user_candidate.name: The Axiom of Exogenous Orthogonality (The Entropy Injector)
user_candidate.statement: To maximize structural orthogonality and prevent localized model collapse, the hypothesis generator must actively synthesize constraints from low-probability, cross-domain knowledge graphs rather than interpolating solely from the software engineering latent space.
user_candidate.operational_rule: When synthesizing a new candidate axiom, the LLM must first select a non-computing domain (such as applied category theory, theoretical linguistics, phenomenological philosophy, or quantum mechanics) and extract a core structural principle from that domain. The proposed system axiom must be a direct topological translation of that exogenous principle into systems architecture.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Low-Probability Exogenous KG] ──> [Domain Semantic Extractor]
                                                │
                                                ▼
                                    [Topological Translator]
                                                │
                                                ▼
                                    [Orthogonal System Invariant]

Knowledge Graph Ingestion.role: Samples low-probability connections outside software engineering (category theory, linguistics, philosophy).

Topological Isomorphism Mapper.role: Translates structural relations from source domains into systems architecture.
Topological Isomorphism Mapper.invariant_rule: Preserves relational symmetries under domain translation.

Entropy Barrier.role: Prevents search collapse back into conventional software engineering idioms.
Entropy Barrier.invariant_rule: Rejects standard SWE idioms without cross-domain mapping.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Injects high entropy into candidate generation, forcing orthogonal hypotheses (+0.0133).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Filters out conventional software idioms before execution (+0.0200).

tradeoffs.strengths: Completely prevents search stagnation and model collapse.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires sophisticated topological mapping logic across domains.
